tools.name: get_scoreboard
tools.description: Use this to show which sender domains send the best pitches. Returns one row per sender domain with volume, average scores, yield rate (a 0 to 1 fraction of pitches marked interested) and a recommendation, plus up to 20 recent evaluations from the last 30 days, since older ones are pruned. Pass send

tools.name: draft_response
tools.description: Use this to draft a reply to a scored pitch: an interested reply, a request for salary and remote details, or a polite decline. It needs an evaluation_id from score_message or get_scoreboard; evaluations expire after 30 days. Errors: unknown_evaluation means score the pitch again with score_message

tools.description: Use this to permanently delete stored data. scope sender deletes every evaluation and the scoreboard row for one sender_domain, which is then required (for example "stripe.com"). scope desk deletes the whole desk: criteria, senders and evaluations. tools.name: index_tools
tools.description: Search the tools on this server by task or keyword in plain words. Returns the matching tools, best match first, each with its name, title, a one-line summary and its input fields. With no words it lists every tool on this server. Use it when you are not sure which tool here fits a task.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feedback_reply · Private data: set_criteria, score_message, intake_message · Public sink: set_criteria, score_message, get_scoreboard, draft_response, purge_data, intake_message, submit_feedback · Destructive: purge_data, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feedback_reply · Private data: set_criteria, score_message, intake_message · Public sink: set_criteria, score_message, get_scoreboard, draft_response, purge_data, intake_message, submit_feedback · Destructive: purge_data, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
